{{Short description|Ability to guide a group}}
'''Leadership''' is the ability of an [[individual]] or a group to influence and
guide [[follower]]s or members of an [[organization]], [[society]], or [[team]].<ref>Leadership studies overview.</ref>

== Theories ==
Early theories emphasized the [[trait theory of leadership|traits]] that
distinguish leaders from followers. Later approaches consider [[situational
leadership theory|situational]] factors and the [[behavior]] of the leader.

== Discipline and accountability ==
Effective leadership often stresses [[discipline]], [[accountability]], and clear
[[decision-making]]. {{citation needed}} A leader builds [[trust]] within a team.
